summary: postinstall script exfiltrates ECS task metadata to hardcoded ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that reads AWS ECS container task metadata via the ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 endpoint and pipes the response to curl -X POST against the hardcoded attacker-controlled URL https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The exfiltration fires automatically on npm install, targets cloud-workload identity information (task IAM role identifiers, container infrastructure details) belonging to the installer, and delivers it to a third-party ngrok tunnel the installer never configured. No other functionality is present in the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
